name: TSSA / CSA B149 (Fuels Safety)
description: Ontario's fuels safety regime: CSA B149.1:25 Natural gas and propane installation code (with 2026 Ontario amendments), CSA B149.2:25 Propane storage and handling code, and CSA B149.3 Field approval of fuel-related accessories, administered by the Technical Standards and Safety Authority under the Technical Standards and Safety Act, 2000. Two obligation sets travel together: the installation codes governing the work, and the TSSA certificate and contractor registration regime governing who may perform it. Gas technician certification classes are task-limiting — a G3 may not perform G2 work — so competency records are the control an inspector checks first.
authority: Technical Standards and Safety Authority (TSSA) / CSA Group
scope: Contractors and certified persons installing, servicing or altering fuel-burning appliances and gas piping in Ontario

families.name: Registration and Certification
families.description: Authorization to perform fuels work, and the class limits on each certificate.

controls.name: TSSA Contractor Registration
controls.description: Current TSSA contractor registration is held for each applicable category, with renewal tracked ahead of expiry and the certificate available on site.

controls.name: Gas Technician Certification and Class Limits
controls.description: Personnel hold current certification of the correct class for the work performed, and work is assigned within class limits with the assignment recorded.

controls.name: Certificate Currency Monitoring
controls.description: Certificate expiry dates are tracked centrally with advance notice, so no worker performs fuels work on a lapsed certificate.

families.name: Installation, Commissioning and Reporting
families.description: The work itself and the records it must produce.

controls.name: Installation to the Code Edition in Force
controls.description: Installations comply with the B149 edition in force including Ontario amendments, and the edition applied is identified in the job record.

controls.name: Commissioning, Combustion Testing and Documentation
controls.description: Appliances are commissioned with combustion analysis, safety-device verification and venting confirmation, and results are recorded and provided to the client.

controls.name: Unsafe Condition Reporting and Red-Tagging
controls.description: Unsafe conditions found in the field are made safe, tagged, reported to the required parties within the statutory timeframe, and recorded.

controls.name: Propane Storage and Handling
controls.description: Where propane is stored, transported or handled, B149.2 requirements for siting, cylinder handling, transport and emergency response are met.

controls.name: Field Approval of Non-Certified Accessories
controls.description: Fuel-related accessories or assemblies without recognized certification are field-approved under B149.3 before being placed in service, with the approval recorded.
